# OpenCode Computer Use for Windows

A Windows computer-use plugin for OpenCode V1, adapted from [dsh-computer-use-win](https://github.com/Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win) 0.5.7. It retains the Windows/browser backends, full settings controls and native progress overlay, and adds signed session/turn context, cross-project desktop ownership, cancellation and live settings.

Requires Windows, Node.js 22+ and OpenCode V1 (tested with 1.18.0). OpenCode V2 is not supported by this entrypoint.

## Install and configure

Install globally from [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-computer-use-win):

~~~powershell
npm install --global opencode-computer-use-win@0.1.3 --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org
npm root --global
~~~

Alternatively, download and extract the tgz from a successful [GitHub Actions artifact](https://github.com/xshu-hub/opencode-computer-use-win/actions), then run:

~~~powershell
npm install --global --omit=dev --ignore-scripts .\opencode-computer-use-win-0.1.3.tgz
npm root --global
~~~

Merge the installed opencode/plugin.mjs file URL into the plugin array in the global OpenCode opencode.json(c), and opencode/tui.mjs into the global tui.json plugin array. Both files normally reside in ~/.config/opencode. Use absolute file URLs and preserve existing entries. Restart OpenCode. Do not also register a manual wincu MCP server or a second source checkout.

The TUI owns the only /computer-use slash command and opens settings without a model request. With OpenCode running, opencode-cu settings also opens the settings window. Other clients can use the computer_use_settings tool.

## Build and verify

~~~powershell
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run build
npm test
npm run test:ui
node test/run-opencode-host.mjs C:/path/to/opencode.exe
npm pack
~~~

CI builds and uploads an installable tarball. npm publication is a separate authenticated step. See [README.md](README.md), [installation details](docs/global-installation.md) and [validation](docs/validation-opencode-2026-11-13.md).

OpenCode V1 has no Desktop GUI settings-page plugin API, so settings open in a local browser window. Conversation tool/image rendering remains in OpenCode. A recording-exclusion regression reproduces in both the adapter and reference backend in the validation environment; the complete upstream suite is not claimed passing.

MIT. Preserve the upstream notices in LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY.md. The settings page omits the upstream promotion/feedback banner; attribution remains in repository documentation.

# OpenCode Computer Use for Windows

面向 OpenCode V1 的 Windows 电脑操控插件。提供 25 项操作工具和 1 项管理入口，支持桌面控件读取、截图、OCR、鼠标键盘输入、窗口管理，以及通过 CDP/BiDi 操作浏览器。

基于 [Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win](https://github.com/Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win) 0.5.7，保留原后端、设置控件和原生浮窗，增加 OpenCode 会话/轮次绑定、跨项目桌面占用控制、取消与恢复、动态工具同步及全局设置入口。来源和许可说明见 [THIRD_PARTY.md](THIRD_PARTY.md)；设置页面不展示项目推广栏。

## 环境

- Windows，正常且已解锁的交互桌面。
- Node.js 22 或更新版本。
- OpenCode V1；实际验证版本为 1.18.0。当前不支持 OpenCode V2 的插件接口。
- 浏览器通道需要本机安装 Edge、Chrome 或受支持的 Firefox 系浏览器。

## 安装

通过 [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-computer-use-win) 全局安装，在 PowerShell 执行：

~~~powershell
npm install --global opencode-computer-use-win@0.1.3 --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org
npm root --global
~~~

也可从 [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/xshu-hub/opencode-computer-use-win/actions) 成功构建的 opencode-computer-use-win artifact 下载并解压 tgz，离线包安装命令为：

~~~powershell
npm install --global --omit=dev --ignore-scripts .\opencode-computer-use-win-0.1.3.tgz
npm root --global
~~~

也可以从源码构建：

~~~powershell
git clone https://github.com/xshu-hub/opencode-computer-use-win.git
cd opencode-computer-use-win
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run build
npm pack
~~~

npm 与 tgz 安装使用相同的全局配置方式，见下文。

## 全局配置

根据 npm root --global 输出，找到包目录。以下示例路径需要替换为自己的实际安装路径。

在用户目录下的 .config/opencode/opencode.json 或 opencode.jsonc 中合并：

~~~json
{
  "plugin": [
    [
      "file:///C:/path/to/node_modules/opencode-computer-use-win/opencode/plugin.mjs",
      { "locale": "zh" }
    ]
  ]
}
~~~

在同目录的 tui.json 中合并：

~~~json
{
  "plugin": [
    "file:///C:/path/to/node_modules/opencode-computer-use-win/opencode/tui.mjs"
  ]
}
~~~

保留现有配置和其他插件，只追加对应条目。重启 OpenCode 后，其他项目会继承全局配置。已有手动 mcp.wincu 条目时，先备份并移除该条目；wincu 由本插件管理。

如果使用源码入口，将示例中的包目录换为自己的源码目录。不要同时注册源码和全局安装包。

更详细的路径获取和升级说明见 [全局安装说明](docs/global-installation.md)。

## 设置入口

- 在 TUI 输入 /computer-use，或从命令面板选择“电脑操控设置 / Computer Use settings”。
- OpenCode 已运行时，在系统终端执行 opencode-cu settings。
- 其他客户端可让 agent 调用 computer_use_settings。

/computer-use 只由 TUI 注册一次，直接打开设置，不调用模型。没有额外的服务端同名斜杠命令，也不需要修改 OpenCode 本体。

设置页保留全部/精简/懒启动/自定义工具方案、逐项开关、浏览器类型与可见性、保留登录、连接现有浏览器、接管提示、鼠标标签、浮窗原文/AI 总结、位置/尺寸/透明度/锁定、快捷键录制和实际预览。支持中英文切换。

数据保存在 %LOCALAPPDATA%\opencode-computer-use-win；可通过 OPENCODE_CU_HOME 指定其他目录。浏览器登录配置与原 DSH 插件隔离。显示设置实时生效；工具或浏览器配置在当前调用结束后重载。并发保存通过版本号检测冲突。

## 执行与停止

工具调用绑定 OpenCode 的真实会话 ID 和执行中的用户轮次，并携带宿主签名。队列中的用户提示、模型重试和系统生成的继续消息不会解除本轮停止。

真实鼠标键盘操作期间可按 Esc 或自定义快捷键停止，本轮后续操作将被拒绝。新用户任务或明确发送“继续”后恢复。浏览器后台操作不监听全局 Esc；使用 OpenCode 的停止按钮取消。原生输入清理结束前保持桌面占用，避免其他项目或会话插入操作。

截图通过标准 MCP 图片块交给 OpenCode，能否参与判断取决于模型及提供方的视觉能力。动作返回 sent 仅说明已发送，应使用新观察或 wait_for 确认效果。

AI 进度总结是可选的额外模型调用，使用当前任务的模型。仅传入受长度限制的操作标签和已公开的助手输出，不传截图、工具参数或完整对话；默认显示原文。

## 已知边界

OpenCode 1.18 没有原生 Desktop GUI 设置页扩展接口，设置通过本地浏览器窗口展示。对话里的工具详情与图片使用 OpenCode 自身的界面，不注入 DSH 专属聊天行分组。

管理员窗口、UAC、应用自身的自动化限制与参考后端相同。录屏隐藏选项的原生回归在验证环境中未通过，原项目也复现相同问题，当前不宣称已经修复。完整 upstream 测试集未被宣称全部通过。

# OpenCode adapter internals

The OpenCode 1.x entrypoint is `plugin.mjs`. It registers `wincu` as a managed stdio MCP server. Do not also configure a manual server with this name.

- `../mcp/request-context.mjs`: authenticates the host-added session/turn/call context. Model-visible tool schemas are unchanged. Managed workers fail closed when context is missing, expired, altered or does not match the active desktop series.
- `activity.mjs`: maps OpenCode assistant messages, tool events and session termination to the reference takeover/progress file protocol. `chat.params` selects the executing user turn; queued prompts and synthetic continuation messages do not grant a new stop scope.
- `desktop-lock.mjs`: OS-owned named-pipe lease across OpenCode projects and processes. It is kept through model thinking and input cleanup, and released at turn end or after the reference 30-second idle interval. A process crash releases the OS resource.
- `store.mjs`: user settings, validation, atomic replacement, optimistic revision checking and serialization of concurrent saves.
- `settings-server.mjs`: an ephemeral loopback settings endpoint; bearer authentication, same-origin checks, strict Host checks and bounded JSON bodies. The browser receives its token in the URL fragment and removes it from the address bar.
- `build.mjs` / `settings-ui.js`: bundle the reference React settings component with a small OpenCode settings transport. The reference controls, validation, tool groups, shortcut recorder and previews are reused.
- `tui.mjs`: the sole owner of the native `/computer-use` command-palette / slash entry. It opens settings directly without a model turn. The server supplies `computer_use_settings` for clients without the TUI extension; it does not register a second slash command.

All Windows UIA, native input, OCR, capture, browser CDP/BiDi and indicator code remains in the reference locations. Only `mcp/server.mjs` adds a private host-context verification step; standalone MCP behavior remains available without `WCU_OPENCODE_TOKEN`. Overlay strings support `WCU_HOST_BRAND`, and the native cursor badge reads that brand.

## Settings application

Presentation settings update through the control file. Browser/tool selection changes wait for in-flight calls, then reconnect through OpenCode's public `client.mcp.add` API. Tool management waits for OpenCode's catalog-change event before the next model request. Settings saved in another plugin window are noticed by all instances. Overlay moves/resizes/lock/close are merged back only when their base values are still current.

The optional AI summary uses the current session's provider/model in a temporary, hidden-agent child session with all tools denied. Only bounded action labels and already-public assistant output are supplied. The temporary session is aborted and deleted after each request. It never receives screenshots, tool arguments, user prompts or another conversation's text.

## Host boundary

OpenCode 1.18.0 has server hooks and TUI extensions but no Desktop GUI settings-page API. Its settings extension therefore opens a local browser window with the full reference controls. Native MCP result/image rendering stays in OpenCode. DSH-specific chat-row grouping is not injected into OpenCode's GUI. OpenCode V2 has a different plugin API and is not claimed compatible with this V1 entrypoint.

Quick start #### 1.1 Install You need a Windows computer with DSH Desktop installed. The plugin uses Windows PowerShell 5.1, which comes with Windows, so there is nothing else to install. 1. Right-click the DSH icon in the taskbar tray, choose **Open DSH Terminal**, and run: ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-computer-use-win ``` 2. Right-click the tray icon again, choose **Quit**, then open DSH Desktop again. Closing the window is not enough: DSH keeps running in the tray and does not load the new plugin. 3. Open **Settings → Computer Use** (the mouse icon; 电脑操控 in the Chinese interface) to look around. You don't have to change anything: all tools are loaded by default. Then give the agent a desktop task, such as one from [section 6](#6-try-a-task). #### 1.2 Upgrade Run the same install command, then fully quit and reopen DSH Desktop as in step 2 above. The `desktop` in the command is the profile that DSH Desktop uses. If you install into another profile, the DSH you are using does not change. #### 1.3 Other ways to install
DSH Web, GitHub, standalone MCP clients For DSH Web: ```powershell dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-computer-use-win ``` Restart `dsh web` after installing. If you use another profile, replace `web` with its name. You can also search the plugin marketplace for **dsh-computer-use-win**, or install from GitHub: ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win ``` Outside DSH, any MCP client can launch it: ```json { "mcpServers": { "wincu": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "dsh-computer-use-win"] } } } ``` DSH Web and standalone MCP clients run the plugin with the Node.js on your computer, which must be version 22 or later. DSH Desktop brings its own runtime, so it needs no separate Node.js. Run on its own, the server loads all tools by default. Set `WCU_TOOL_MODE=lite` to load only the common tools, or `WCU_TOOL_MODE=lazy` to start with just the management entry. You can also list the allowed tools as a JSON array in `WCU_ENABLED_TOOLS`. The settings page, the action records in conversations and the turn-wide indicators exist only inside DSH. See [tool loading](docs/tool-context.md) for details.
### 2. Interface tour These are real screenshots from DSH Desktop 2.0.18, with the Chinese interface. Each image shows only the browser window, the conversation or the settings panel; click one to see it at full size. The settings screenshots come from 0.5.4. The browser screenshot comes from 0.5.2 and the conversation screenshots from an earlier search task; neither part of the interface has changed since. The overlay images replay the record of a real task through the plugin's own overlay code. #### 2.1 Web pages are worked on in the DSH browser Web tasks go to Browser Use by default. DSH works in a browser window of its own: the window frame is DSH blue, the tab it works in shows a blue arrow as its icon, and a small glowing arrow on the page marks where it clicks. It reads pages, fills in forms and presses buttons through the browser's debugging protocol, without moving your pointer or bringing the window to the front, so you can keep using other apps. The screenshot shows the window while it filled in a sample expense form in the background (a demo page; the name is made up). ![Real screenshot of the DSH browser: a blue window frame, a blue arrow as the tab icon, a filled-in sample expense form and a small glowing arrow on the submit button](assets/desktop-browser-use-hd.png) #### 2.2 Every step shows up in the conversation Each desktop action is a row with a mouse icon, such as “Entered text”, “Sent a key press” or “Checked the result” (the screenshot shows the Chinese labels). Click **Steps and screenshots** to see the details and screenshots of each step. ![Real search demonstration: mouse-icon conversation rows for text input, key presses and result checks, with a steps and screenshots entry](assets/desktop-search-steps-hd.png) #### 2.3 Reasoning and progress overlay While DSH works on the computer, a translucent overlay in a corner of the screen shows what it is thinking and doing, step by step. Each step gets a heading with its action, followed by the reasoning for that step, the same text you see in the conversation. When the task ends, the heading shows that it is done, with the number of steps and the time taken, and the overlay shows the reply from its start for another 20 seconds. 最常见的原因是 DSH Desktop 没有完全重启：只关窗口时，DSH 还在托盘里运行旧版插件。请右键托盘图标选“退出”，再重新打开。 也要确认插件装到了 DSH 正在用的 profile。版本号可以在 MCP 返回的 `initialize.serverInfo.version` 里看；选“全部”方案时，也可以让 agent 调用 `health` 检查连接。同一个 profile 里只应有一个 `serverName: wincu` 服务。如果旧版本留下过重复的手动配置，先备份，再按[升级说明](docs/computer-use-settings.md)处理。 保存设置后，DSH 会在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里写一条 `id: mcp-dsh-computer-use-win` 的记录，里面就是你的设置。这条记录是正常的，不要删。选了“精简”或“懒启动”时，不在方案里的工具（比如 `health`）本来就不会出现，直接调用会显示 unknown tool。让 agent 调用管理入口 `windows_computer_use_tools`（`{"operation":"list"}`），就能看到哪些工具已经加载、哪些还能加载。如果保存的设置里有这个版本不认识的值，比如换过版本以后，插件会对这一项改用默认值、照常加载，并在 `tools` 列表的 `notices` 和 `health` 里写明改了哪一项。 提交问题时，请附上 DSH Desktop、dsh 内核和插件的版本号，以及去掉隐私后的报错文字。 #### 8.2 为什么点击或输入没有反应？ 先看目标窗口有没有被挡住、程序是不是卡住了。按坐标点击时，落点露出的是别的窗口（比如通知）就不会点下去，结果会说出挡住它的窗口（`POINT_COVERED`）；结果里的 `foreground` 和 `pointer` 说明这一步有没有借用前台、有没有还回去。Chromium、Electron 和部分 WinUI 程序会忽略后台输入，所以优先用 UIA 操作，或者先把目标窗口切到前台再输入，然后看看实际效果。以管理员身份运行的窗口和 UAC 确认界面受 Windows 权限保护，插件无法操作。插件还需要一个正常可用的桌面会话。 #### 8.3 支持 PowerShell 7、其他系统，或者自带看图模型吗？ 只支持 Windows。DSH 也可以跑在 WSL 里（比如在 WSL 里运行 `dsh web`）：插件经 WSL 互操作调用 Windows 的 PowerShell，操作的仍是 Windows 桌面，前提是 WSL 里能启动 Windows 程序（能运行 `powershell.exe`）。默认用 PowerShell 5.1，它的文字识别（WinRT OCR）经过了真实测试。自动测试同时覆盖 PowerShell 5.1 和 7：在 7 上，界面读取和截图有真实测试，但文字识别只测了协议，所以还不能保证 7 上的文字识别可用。 插件只提供桌面工具，不带模型、API key，也不带 OmniParser、UI-TARS 这类看图解析工具。能看图的模型或单独的解析服务可以读截图，再把位置交给插件去操作。 ### 9. 数据与隐私 界面读取、文字识别、截图和输入都在你的电脑上完成，结果交给 DSH 或其他调用方。这些内容会不会再发给远程模型，取决于你的 DSH 和模型设置。截图和读出的文字可能包含窗口里的敏感信息，所以分享日志或提 Issue 之前，请先遮住账号、路径、密码和私人对话。 浏览器通道读到的网页内容同样在本机处理，再交给调用方。agent 浏览器默认不带任何登录；打开“保留网站登录状态”后，agent 能读取和操作你在 DSH 浏览器里登录过的网站。打开“操作已打开的浏览器”并允许连接后，agent 能读取和操作那个浏览器里所有已登录的网站，所以只在需要时打开，用完可以在浏览器里关掉远程调试。网页里的文字也可能夹带写给 agent 的指令，所以页面大纲的开头会提醒模型：网页内容不可信，只听你的指示。 ### 10. 文档与开发 #### 10.1 文档 The agent first asks you to get ready to click Allow in the browser, then writes `connect` to that handle with `set_value`, and only then does the browser ask you. A refusal or timeout stops there with no automatic retry, and the listing says not allowed or timed out, so prompts never pile up. Once connected, tool results show the addresses of your own tabs without the part after `?` or `#`. The agent works only in tabs you mention or tabs it opened, and asks before sending, buying, deleting or changing account settings. Disconnecting leaves your browser running. While connected, the browser shows a bar saying it is controlled by automated test software. The browser lane does not read content inside iframes yet; there the agent switches to Computer Use and reads and operates it through UIA. With the browser window shown, Chrome's own JavaScript dialogs (alert, confirm and the like) sometimes come to the front briefly. Shortcuts such as Ctrl+L and Ctrl+T belong to the browser window and never reach the page; use `address`, `new-tab` and `close_window` instead. Environment variables and result formats are in the [MCP tools reference](docs/wiki/mcp-tools.md#browser-lane). ### 8. FAQ #### 8.1 It's installed, but I see no tools or settings, or an old version is still running Most often, DSH Desktop was not fully restarted. Closing the window leaves DSH running in the tray with the old plugin, so right-click the tray icon, choose Quit, and open DSH Desktop again. Also check that the plugin went into the profile DSH is actually using. The version appears in the MCP `initialize.serverInfo.version`; with All selected, the agent can also call `health` to check the connection. Each profile should have only one `serverName: wincu` service. If an older version left a duplicate manual entry, back it up first, then follow the [upgrade notes](docs/computer-use-settings.md). When you save settings, DSH writes a row with `id: mcp-dsh-computer-use-win` into the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. That row holds your settings, so keep it. With Lite or Lazy selected, tools outside the preset, such as `health`, are not listed, and calling one directly returns unknown tool. Ask the agent to call the management entry `windows_computer_use_tools` with `{"operation":"list"}` to see which tools are loaded and which can be loaded. If a saved setting holds a value this version does not offer, for example after switching versions, the plugin uses the default for that setting, loads as usual, and names the reset value under `notices` in the tools list and in `health`. When you report an issue, include the DSH Desktop, dsh core and plugin versions, plus the error text with private details removed. #### 8.2 Why did a click or typed text have no effect? Check that the target window is not covered and still responds. A click at a screen position whose point shows another window, such as a notification, is not sent, and the result names the covering window (`POINT_COVERED`). The `foreground` and `pointer` fields of a result say whether the step borrowed the foreground and whether it gave it back. Chromium, Electron and some WinUI apps ignore input sent to background windows, so prefer UIA, or bring the window to the front before typing, and then look at the result. Windows protects apps running as administrator and the UAC prompt, so the plugin cannot operate them. The plugin also needs a normal, unlocked desktop session. #### 8.3 What about PowerShell 7, other systems or a built-in vision model? It works on Windows only. DSH can also run inside WSL (for example `dsh web` in a WSL shell): the plugin then starts Windows PowerShell through WSL interop and still operates the Windows desktop, as long as WSL can start Windows programs (`powershell.exe` runs). PowerShell 5.1 is the default, and its text recognition (WinRT OCR) has been tested on real screens. The automated tests cover both PowerShell 5.1 and 7. Under 7, reading controls and taking screenshots are tested for real, but text recognition is only tested at the protocol level, so OCR under PowerShell 7 is not guaranteed. The plugin provides desktop tools only. It does not include a model, an API key, or image parsers such as OmniParser or UI-TARS. A model that can see images, or a separate parsing service, can read the screenshots and pass positions back to the tools. ### 9. Data and privacy Reading controls, text recognition, screenshots and input all run on your computer. The results go to DSH or another caller, and whether they are then sent to a remote model depends on your DSH and model settings. Screenshots and recognized text can include sensitive content from your windows, so hide accounts, paths, passwords and private chats before you share logs or open an issue. Pages read through the browser lane are also processed on your computer before they go to the caller. By default the agent browser carries no sign-ins; with Keep website sign-ins on, the agent can read and operate the sites you signed in to in the DSH browser. With Use an already open browser on and a connection allowed, the agent can read and operate every site signed in to in that browser, so turn it on only when needed, and you can turn remote debugging off in the browser afterwards. Page text can also carry instructions aimed at the agent, so every page outline starts by reminding the model that page content is untrusted and only your instructions count. ### 10. # Experimental Firefox-family Browser Use

This experimental backend implements the optional browser lane requested in #56. It is separate from the Gecko desktop accessibility fix. Chrome and Edge retain their CDP backend. The default browser choice still falls back to Chrome/Edge when the Windows default is another engine; Firefox is an explicit opt-in.

## Automatic isolated launch

In Computer Use settings select **Firefox family (experimental)**, or set `WCU_BROWSER_APP=firefox`. The Firefox that the plugin starts always runs headless: the settings page turns **Show the browser window** off while Firefox is selected, and `health` and `list_windows` report `visible: false`. Use `WCU_BROWSER_EXE` for a particular Firefox-family executable.

Discovery tries the Windows default browser first when its ProgId is a Firefox one (`FirefoxURL-…`), so a fork set as the default, such as Vantage, wins over a plain Firefox installed beside it. Then it reads the registered App Paths. Each candidate must carry the Firefox App.ID in its `application.ini`; neither the executable name nor the reported `browserName` has to be `firefox`. Registry output is decoded in the OEM code page, so browsers installed under Chinese or other non-ASCII folders are found.

The backend creates its own profile under `WCU_BROWSER_PROFILE` (by default the plugin's agent-browser directory). It never opens the user's normal Firefox profile. `WCU_BROWSER_SIGNIN=1` keeps a separate profile keyed by executable; normal shutdown asks Firefox to flush cookies. One process owns that profile through its `dsh-bidi-owner` file, which holds the owner's process id. While that process runs, another server gets `BROWSER_PROFILE_BUSY` instead of an unsupported second BiDi session. When the owner crashed or was killed, the next launch finds its process gone and takes the profile over.

## Connect a separately started endpoint

Start Firefox with a **dedicated automation profile** and `--remote-debugging-port 9222`, then set `WCU_BROWSER_BIDI_URL=ws://127.0.0.1:9222/session` in the MCP server environment. The URL must be a loopback WebSocket endpoint. This explicit URL selects BiDi without requiring the browser selector. Do not point it at your normal daily profile.

The lane creates one session and discovers existing tabs through `list_windows`. A second controller is rejected while that session is active. If session creation fails because another controller owns it, this backend does not end the other's session. On normal shutdown it ends only its own session; it does not close the externally supplied browser or its tabs. Reconnect obtains new element/tab IDs. Visible externally supplied windows have not been validated for focus preservation.

## Supported workflow and limits

Use the same tools: `set_value` on `new-tab` opens a URL; `list_windows` lists tab IDs; `accessibility_tree`/`snapshot` with `browserTab` returns a DOM outline; use its IDs for click, input, focus, field values and inspection. Navigation invalidates previous element IDs. Alerts, confirms and prompts are reported and can be answered with Enter/Escape and prompt text. Screenshot dimensions describe the actual PNG.

The outline is based on DOM heuristics, not a native accessibility tree. Links, buttons, headings, cells and paragraphs are named by their text; lists, rows, tables and other containers only by text that no listed element inside them shows, so each text appears once. Tab ids carry 64 random bits, as in the Chromium lane. Iframe contents, closed shadow roots, canvas hit testing, file upload/download handling, blue status indicators, cross-MCP session sharing and automatic crash recovery are not implemented. Screenshots currently retain viewport size even if `maxWidth` is smaller; the result states this limitation. Scrolling uses DOM scrolling; Firefox 158's headless native wheel was observed to report success without changing scroll position. Do not interpret dispatched input as task success: inspect the resulting page.

The shipped tests cover a real Firefox 158 headless local fixture and a separately managed headless endpoint. Other Firefox forks, older ESR releases and visible endpoint focus behavior still need testing. Successful cookie persistence is not evidence that an interactive login flow has been tested.

## Tests

```text
node test/browser-bidi.mjs
node test/browser-bidi.mjs --live
```

Use `WCU_TEST_OUTPUT` for isolated test artifacts. Tests use local pages and their own profiles. Set `WCU_BROWSER_EXE` when Firefox is not installed at a registered/discoverable location.

# 电脑操控设置 / Computer Use settings

## 简体中文

升级插件并完整退出、重新启动 DSH Desktop，打开 **设置 → 电脑操控**（鼠标图标；英文界面叫 Computer Use）。新版插件页面也有入口；旧宿主保留可配置插件卡片。DSH 0.2 使用插件条目 ID `mcp-dsh-computer-use-win` 的 Config 表单；旧接口使用 `windows-computer-use`。

若曾为 #29 手动添加独立的 `windows-computer-use` 或 `wincu` 覆盖条目，请先备份 profile 配置，再移除该临时重复条目，使用插件 bundle 提供的入口。避免同时启动两个桌面操作服务。

插件列表显示功能简介和“点击进行具体设置”，点击打开完整设置页；Star 和 Issue 链接位于完整设置页顶部；点“折叠”可将这段说明收为一个带 GitHub 标志的 dsh-computer-use-win 链接，点“展开”恢复。该选择立即保存，重启和升级后保持不变，也不会保存或放弃其他未保存的更改。无法读取宿主配置时会暂停编辑并明确提示，不再将内置默认值当作已经读取的设置。0.4.3 补齐混合版本验证器的实时字段与共享引用协议，使用宿主确认的值回读保存结果。

### 浏览器操控（Browser Use）

默认打开“网页优先用浏览器操控”和“显示浏览器窗口”。DSH 专用浏览器单独启动，用哪个浏览器由“使用的浏览器”决定：默认跟随 Windows 的默认浏览器，默认浏览器不是 Edge 或 Chrome 时用已安装的 Chrome 或 Edge。默认使用临时的空白配置，不加载扩展，不带你的登录、Cookie 和浏览记录（打开“记住登录”后改用保留的配置，见下段）；退出 DSH 或空闲 10 分钟后自动关闭。窗口请求在后台创建，普通网页操作不移动系统鼠标；Chrome 的 JavaScript 模态弹窗实测可能短暂来到前台，不能保证可见浏览器始终不影响焦点；你可以自己切换标签页观看。提示参照 Codex 的浏览器操控，不遮挡网页内容：专用浏览器的窗口框是 DSH 蓝，和你自己的浏览器一眼能分开；DSH 正在操作的标签页，图标换成蓝色箭头，这一轮结束后换回网页自己的图标；网页上一个带光晕的小箭头停在 DSH 点的位置，鼠标点击会穿过它，截图里也没有它。关掉“显示浏览器窗口”后，浏览器在后台运行，没有窗口。JavaScript 模态弹窗会暂停页面脚本，标签页图标在弹窗关闭后同步。

多个 DSH 会话使用同一个保留配置时共用浏览器。结束最早启动它的会话不会关闭其他会话正在用的标签页；最后一个会话退出后正常关闭并保存 Cookie。所有服务意外结束时，独立清理进程会在确认没有活跃会话后关闭浏览器。不同会话的“显示浏览器窗口”设置不一致时会明确报冲突，先结束旧会话或统一设置再重试。

“记住登录（cookies）”默认关闭。打开后，DSH 专用浏览器给每个浏览器保留一个配置（`%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-computer-use-win\agent-browser` 下的 `kept-edge`、`kept-chrome`），不再每次用临时配置：你在它的窗口里登录过的网站，之后的任务里还是登录状态，会话 Cookie 也保留。第一次用到要登录的网站时，agent 会请你在这个窗口里登录一次，密码和验证码由你自己输入；“显示浏览器窗口”关着时要先打开它。使用 DSH 专用浏览器时不用设置你自己的浏览器，也不弹允许提示。另选“连接我自己的浏览器”时按下面的实验选项说明操作。用 Edge 时，Edge 会自动用 Windows 上的微软账户登录这个配置，微软自家的网站直接是登录状态（实测 Edge 156 没有开关能关掉）；不想这样就选 Chrome。关掉开关后登录仍然保留，要全部清除，退出 DSH 后删除这个文件夹。打开这个开关时，设置页会说明这些，并列出风险：DSH 会以你的身份操作你在这里登录过的网站；网页上的文字可能诱导 agent；DSH 浏览器开着时，本机其他程序也能通过它的调试端口连上它。更改这两项会在当前动作结束后重连插件服务，并关闭已打开的 DSH 浏览器。

浏览器操控、读取界面（截图、控件树、文字识别、等待）和在后台完成的控件操作，都不显示屏幕边缘、提示条和鼠标标签，也不挂全局 Esc：这样的一轮操作里，你在其他程序按 Esc 不会被拦下；要停止，用 DSH 里的停止按钮。同一轮里一旦用到真实的鼠标或键盘，接管提示和 Esc 从这一步开始照常生效；按 Esc 停下的一轮，后续的浏览器操控也不再执行。

网页能完成的步骤优先使用浏览器通道；原生应用、浏览器工具栏、无可用 CDP 连接、iframe 内容和 canvas 坐标动作，转为同一目标窗口的 UIA，再用截图/OCR/坐标兜底。必须重新读取桌面状态，不把网页坐标当屏幕坐标。不确定是否成功的动作先观察再决定，不能盲目重放。停止、取消、权限拒绝、禁用或只读控件，不允许通过桌面输入绕过。临时浏览器没有用户登录状态，不能代替已登录工作流。精简/自定义禁用 set_value 时不能新开标签页。设置修改在当前动作完成后重连，会关闭临时浏览器。

Firefox 系网页通道为实验功能：选择“Firefox 系（实验性）”后，自动启动需关闭“显示浏览器窗口”；也可以通过显式 BiDi 端点连接单独启动的浏览器。默认浏览器选项仍按上述 Chrome/Edge 规则回退。Firefox 不具备上述蓝色状态提示、可见登录和多会话共享流程；具体范围见 [BiDi 说明](browser-bidi.md)。桌面通道读取现有 Gecko 窗口无需启用实验选项。

### 工具加载

在 **全部 / 精简 / 懒启动 / 自定义** 一排选项里选择，默认全部 26 项（25 项操作工具加管理入口），下方一行说明当前方案。每项设置左边是一张随设置变化的小示意图，右边是名称和开关，两项一行。详细说明收在 ⓘ 图标里，鼠标停上去、点一下或用键盘聚焦时在图标上方弹出，不会被鼠标指针挡住；鼠标可以移到说明上，点一下后移开也不消失，按 Esc 或点别处关闭。精简固定加载 12 项；自定义才展开内部缩进清单，支持逐项、分组、全选和全部关闭。切换方案会保留自定义勾选，保存后在当前动作结束时生效，重启保留选择。agent 不能重新启用用户关闭的工具。

懒启动仅注册管理入口，允许全部工具按需加载；启动显示“1 项，允许全部 26 项”。切换回自定义会恢复原清单。使用桌面工具前需要加载，`reset` 恢复为管理入口。

### 接管提示

屏幕边缘光晕与提示条、鼠标光斑／DSH 标签独立开关。提示位置、远程与录屏可见、提示文字和结束后的隐藏延时（200–3000 毫秒）收在“更多选项”里；示意图跟着开关和提示位置变化；保存后点标题旁的“预览”查看屏幕上的实际效果。提示层不抢焦点、鼠标可穿透，不修改系统光标主题。提示文字保持默认时跟随 DSH 的界面语言，浮窗文字和 AI 总结也一样。

“远程与录屏可见”默认开启，让 UU、屏幕共享及录屏可以捕获提示和思考与操作浮窗，包括浮窗里模型的思考和回复。关闭后请求 Windows 在支持的捕获路径中排除这些内容。组件通过原生活动显示器枚举、显示／会话事件及接管期间 500 毫秒复核刷新，处理虚拟屏幕新增、移除、重连和布局／DPI 变化。

DSH 从一轮操作第一次用到鼠标或键盘开始持续显示提示，包括之后的截图、读取和短暂思考。轮次完成、取消或异常退出后按延时收起；最后一次工具活动或模型输出后空闲 30 秒，也会收起提示并释放占用，下一次调用重新显示。仍在执行的动作不会被当作空闲。普通文件读写或 shell 命令不单独触发提示。其他对话正在接管桌面时返回忙碌状态，避免两个任务交错操作鼠标。宿主活动租约过期后会释放提示。独立 stdio 客户端没有 DSH 的轮次边界，保持单次调用显示。

### 对话中的操作记录

工具调用使用鼠标图标和简洁操作描述，点击展开相关截图与检查入口。轮次结束后汇总步骤；重开对话时从已有会话事件恢复。输入已发送与效果已验证分开表达，未完成和已停止会明确显示。浏览器搜索摘要以实际输入、提交和后续观察为依据。

控件操作优先在后台完成：Win32 按钮用 BM_CLICK，输入框用 EM_REPLACESEL，带滚动条的控件用 WM_VSCROLL，其他控件用 UIA，不动鼠标、不抢前台；有的程序在 UIA 调用里会自己切到前台或移动鼠标，插件随即还回去。坐标点击、粘贴和按键仍用当前 Windows 桌面的真实鼠标键盘：目标窗口只在这一步来到前面，点击前检查落点没有被别的窗口挡住；做完后，鼠标若还停在 DSH 放的位置就移回你原来的位置，前台还给你原来的窗口。动作打开了菜单、下拉列表或对话框，或者你中途换了窗口、移了鼠标，就保持现状。前台还给你之后，不指定窗口的后续操作仍对准 DSH 刚操作的窗口。粘贴的文字不进剪贴板历史（Win+V），粘贴后恢复原来的剪贴板。

### 停止与恢复

按物理 **Esc** 停止。也可在“自定义停止方式”点击“录制快捷键”，按 F8 或 Ctrl + Alt + K 等按键／组合键并保存；标题旁的“恢复默认（Esc）”清除额外快捷键。录制时 Esc 用于取消；失焦或 15 秒未录入会退出录制。

Esc 只停止当前这一轮及其排队操作，同一轮不会自动重试。下次发起任务或发送“继续”时自动可用，无需进入设置恢复。普通鼠标移动与其他按键不会停止；程序发送的按键不视为物理停止输入。关闭提示仍保留停止监听。浏览器操控、读取界面和后台控件操作不占用 Esc；一轮操作用到鼠标键盘之前，要停止请用 DSH 里的停止按钮。

取消会在可分段输入与 UIA 解析后的执行边界检查，并在收尾时释放按住的输入。已送达应用的操作无法撤回，阻塞的应用 Provider 调用需要先返回。按 Esc 不会请求重启或退出 DSH，也不能据此判断应用崩溃。

## English

Upgrade and fully restart DSH Desktop, then open **Settings → Computer Use** (mouse icon; 电脑操控 in the Chinese interface). A plugin-page entry and the legacy configurable card are also available. Modern DSH uses the `mcp-dsh-computer-use-win` Config namespace; the older API uses `windows-computer-use`. Back up and remove any temporary duplicate adapter/MCP override added for #29 before using the bundled entry.

The plugin list shows a short introduction that opens the complete settings page. Star and Issue links stay at the top of that page; Collapse folds that note into one dsh-computer-use-win link with the GitHub mark and Expand restores it. The choice saves at once, persists across restarts and upgrades, and neither saves nor discards other pending changes. An unavailable host form shows an explicit state and cannot be edited. Version 0.4.3 supplies live-field metadata and the shared reference protocol for mixed-version validators, and confirms saved values against the host response.

Prefer Browser Use for web pages and Show the browser window are on by default. The DSH browser starts separately, in the browser chosen under Browser (by default the Windows default browser, and an installed Chrome or Edge when that is neither), with no extensions and, by default, a temporary empty profile: none of your sign-ins, cookies or history (with Keep sign-ins on it keeps one profile instead; see below). It closes when DSH exits or after 10 idle minutes. Its window is requested in the background and page actions never move the desktop pointer. Chrome JavaScript modal dialogs may briefly activate the window, so visible operation is not an unconditional focus guarantee. As in Codex's Browser Use, nothing covers the page: the window frame is DSH blue, so it is never taken for your own browser; the tab DSH works in shows a blue arrow as its icon until the turn ends, then its own icon again; and a small glowing arrow rests where DSH clicks. Clicks pass through the arrow, and screenshots leave it out. With Show the browser window off, the browser runs in the background with no window. Browser Use, reads (screenshots, control trees, OCR, waits) and control actions done in the background show no screen edges, banner or pointer tag and arm no global Esc, so Esc keeps working in your other apps; stop such a turn with the stop button in DSH. Once a turn uses the real mouse or keyboard, the indicator and Esc apply from that call on, and a series stopped with Esc refuses its later Browser Use calls too.

DSH sessions using the same kept profile share one browser. Ending its first client preserves other clients’ tabs; the last client closes it gracefully to save cookies. A detached cleanup watcher closes it after all clients unexpectedly exit. Conflicting Show browser window settings produce an explicit error; end the older session or align the settings before retrying.

Keep sign-ins (cookies) is off by default. When on, the DSH browser keeps one profile per browser (`kept-edge`, `kept-chrome` under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-computer-use-win\agent-browser`) instead of a temporary one: sites you sign in to in its window stay signed in for later tasks, session cookies included. The first time a task needs a site that asks you to sign in, the agent asks you to sign in once in that window; you type passwords and codes yourself, and Show the browser window must be on. Your own browser is never touched: no remote debugging to turn on and no prompts to allow. With Edge, Edge signs this profile in with the Microsoft account of your Windows, so Microsoft’s own sites are signed in already (Edge 156 has no switch for this); choose Chrome to avoid it. Sign-ins stay when you turn the switch off; to remove them all, exit DSH and delete the folder. With the switch on, the settings page explains this and lists the risks: DSH acts as you on the sites you signed in to there; page text can try to steer the agent; and while the DSH browser runs, other programs on this computer can connect to it through its debugging port. Changing Browser or Keep sign-ins reconnects the plugin’s server after the current action and closes open DSH browsers.

Firefox-family Browser Use is experimental: select Firefox family, or configure a separately started BiDi endpoint. The Firefox that the plugin starts runs headless, so choosing Firefox family turns Show the browser window off and locks it until another browser is chosen, which restores its earlier state. Discovery starts with the Windows default browser when it is a Firefox-family one. The default selection retains its Chrome/Edge fallback. The blue status UI, automatic visible sign-in and cross-client sharing described above do not apply to BiDi; see [its scope](browser-bidi.md). Gecko desktop accessibility does not require this option.

Choose **All / Lite / Lazy / Custom** in one row; a line below describes the selected preset, and each setting shows a small picture of its effect beside its name and switch, two to a row. Details open above the ⓘ icon on hover, click or keyboard focus, so the pointer never covers them; the pointer can move onto the text, a click keeps it open, and Esc or a click elsewhere closes it. All is the default (26 entries); Lite loads 12. Custom reveals the indented checklist with individual/group selection, select-all and disable-all. Preset changes preserve your custom selection. Save applies after the current action finishes and survives restart. Management cannot re-enable user-disabled tools.

Lazy starts with one management entry while allowing all tools to be loaded on demand. Switching back to Custom restores its saved list; reset returns Lazy to management only.

The screen edge glow/status pill and the pointer glow/DSH tag have independent controls. Their pictures follow the switches and the top/bottom placement. Customize text, placement and the 200–3000ms hide delay under More options, save and preview. The layers let clicks pass through, keep focus and leave Windows cursor themes intact. **Visible in remote sessions and recordings** is on by default, including virtual displays, and also covers the progress overlay, so screen sharing and recordings see its text, including the model's reasoning and replies. Turning it off requests capture exclusion for the indicators and the overlay on supported Windows capture paths. Active monitor enumeration, display/session events and a 500ms topology check refresh the layers after display, layout or DPI changes. The indicators cover this plugin's complete desktop operation series, or a requested preview.

Physical **Esc**, or a recorded key/combination, stops the current operation series and queued input. It cannot retry in the same turn. A new user task or request to continue can use the desktop automatically, without visiting settings. Record a shortcut and save; Restore default (Esc), next to the section title, clears the additional key. Esc cancels recording, and blur or 15 seconds of inactivity exits it. Ordinary mouse movement, other keys and injected keys do not trigger a physical stop. Hiding the indicator keeps the listener active. Browser Use, reads and background control actions do not take Esc; until a turn first uses the mouse or keyboard, stop it with the stop button in DSH.

In DSH, indicators appear with the first call that uses the real mouse or keyboard and stay visible through later observations and short reasoning gaps. They release on turn completion/cancellation, or after 30 idle seconds following the last completed desktop call; the next call shows them again. Running tools do not count as idle. A host lease releases stale state; another conversation receives a busy result while the desktop is owned. Standalone stdio clients retain per-call indicators because they provide no DSH turn boundary. Regular mouse movement does not stop a series.

Conversation rows use a mouse icon and readable action descriptions, expandable screenshots and an end-of-turn summary reconstructed from session events. Sent input is distinguished from verified effects. Element operations run in the background where they can: BM_CLICK for Win32 buttons, EM_REPLACESEL for edits, WM_VSCROLL for controls with their own scroll bars, else UIA, with no pointer or foreground change; when an app brings itself forward or moves the pointer during a UIA call, the plugin gives both back. Coordinate clicks, pastes and key presses still use the shared Windows pointer and keyboard: the target comes forward for that step only, a click point covered by another window is refused, and afterwards the pointer returns to where you left it (if it is still where DSH put it) and the foreground to the window you had in front. A menu, drop-down or dialog the action opened, or a window or pointer you changed meanwhile, is left as it is. After the foreground goes back, later actions without a window target still aim at DSH's window. Pasted text stays out of clipboard history (Win+V), and the previous clipboard is restored.

Cancellation is cooperative at segmented-input and post-resolution execution boundaries, with held-input cleanup. Delivered actions cannot be undone, and a blocking application Provider call must return first. Esc does not request an application exit or restart and is not evidence of an application crash.

## 思考与操作浮窗

默认打开，可在 **设置 → 电脑操控 → 思考与操作浮窗** 随时关闭，选择会保存。开始一轮电脑操控后，按步骤显示 DSH 在做什么：每一步一个小标题，例如“第 3 步 · 连续执行 7 个操作：滚动页面”，下面是这一步模型已输出的思考和回复。动作名只来自工具名和调用结构（新开标签页、批量里有几个操作等），不显示输入的文字、网址或坐标。较早的步骤只保留末尾几行，最近 24 步可以往回滚。模型没有提供思考文本时只显示状态，不生成额外的思考内容。只显示当前占用电脑操控的会话。

任务结束后，标题改为“已完成 · N 步 · 用时”（停止时为“已停止”，出错时为“出错”），浮窗再保留 20 秒；回复比窗口长时从回复开头显示（超过 1200 字的回复显示前 1200 字，以“…”结尾），之后收起。租约过期时直接收起。

详细设置默认收起在 **更多选项** 中，展开后可调整不透明度、大小、位置和锁定快捷键。显示开关、锁定开关与 **打开浮窗并调整** 按钮始终可见。

**浮窗内容** 提供两种模式，默认选择 **直接显示 DSH 输出**：按步骤转发现有输出，不额外调用模型、不增加模型 token。选择 **AI 总结当前操作** 后，使用当前对话所选的模型（不开推理），把已完成的步骤和正在做的操作写成一两句易懂的话，会额外消耗输入和输出 token：开始约 1.5 秒后请求第一条，之后最多每 10 秒一次，内容不变时不重复请求；任务结束时再请求一次结果总结。新的一步不会打断正在生成的总结，上一条总结一直显示到下一条出来，标题注明是第几步时的总结。输入只有动作名和已经显示的文字，限 2400 字符；输出最多 192 token，8 秒超时。总结不会加入对话上下文，也不会执行工具；暂不可用时显示操作步骤，结束后显示回复原文。关闭浮窗、切回原文或换到下一轮会取消在途总结，已消耗的 token 不能撤回。约 40 秒的任务大约请求 4–5 次。

不透明度可设 20–100%，宽度 240–1600 像素，高度 160–1600 像素；位置可选四角或自定义 X/Y（支持负坐标）。锁定时不抢焦点、鼠标穿透，不会挡住你或 DSH 的点击。右上角的锁形图标就是锁定按钮：把光标移上去停约 0.4 秒（按钮上转一圈进度环），浮窗临时解锁，可以拖标题移动、拖边缘缩放、滚动正文；光标离开浮窗约 1.5 秒后自动锁回，点开锁图标则立即锁回。临时解锁不改锁定设置，期间的移动和缩放照常保存；锁回后光标要先离开按钮，再停上去才会再次解锁。悬停解锁只认物理鼠标（低级鼠标钩子里没有注入标记的移动），DSH 用 SendInput 发出的输入和用 SetCursorPos 移过去的光标都不会触发；远程控制软件注入的鼠标同样不会触发，这时请用锁定开关或快捷键。解锁时（设置里关闭锁定、预览或悬停解锁）右上角是开锁图标和 ×：点开锁图标锁定（设置里本来是解锁的，会把锁定写回设置），点 × 关闭浮窗。正在悬停解锁或拖动时，任务结束、保留期满或预览到时都会等调整完再收起。锁定快捷键可自定义，例如 `Ctrl+Alt+P`，再次按下切换锁定；不能使用 Esc 或与停止键重复。留空时仍可从设置页切换锁定。

正文使用连续的只读滚动区，段落之间不空行，Markdown 记号去掉、只留文字；只显示整行，上下边缘不会切掉半行。文字带细微阴影，背后是亮色网页时也能看清。解锁后可用滚轮和右侧半透明滚动条阅读（没有更多内容时不显示滚动条），拖动标题栏移动窗口，边缘仍可缩放。向上滚动时保留阅读位置；回到底部后再跟随新增输出。锁定时鼠标穿透，右上角显示锁形按钮，不显示底部提示行，正文多出一行；需要滚动回看时把光标停在锁形按钮上解锁。仅切换锁定不会把四角定位改成自定义坐标。宽高还受 Windows 当前显示器的窗口跟踪上限约束。

点 **打开浮窗并调整** 会直接应用浮窗设置并显示 60 秒的调整预览，不必先保存，表单里其他未保存的更改保留；预览期间临时解锁，方便拖动和缩放，结束后恢复原来的锁定状态（预览中按锁定快捷键或改锁定开关才会保存）；内容是两步示例，普通浮窗开关关闭时也能预览。此页与浮窗共用宿主配置：菜单修改实时应用，拖动、缩放、锁定和关闭通过 DSH 官方设置服务写回，重启后保留。过时的浮窗位置事件不会覆盖更新的菜单设置；连续两次快速拖动或缩放时，第一次写回设置后的回传也不会把浮窗拉回原处。浮窗只展示进度，不会单独启用桌面 Esc 接管；浏览器后台任务仍使用 DSH 的停止按钮。

## 连接自己的浏览器（实验性）

`browserAttachUser` 默认关闭。开启前在 `chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging` 或 `edge://inspect/#remote-debugging` 允许远程调试。只连接设置中选定的浏览器；默认选项跟随 Windows 默认浏览器，不扫描所有浏览器。Firefox 系不支持此选项。

`list_windows` 只显示可连接项和 `"<browser id>:connect"`，不握手。agent 先告知用户去浏览器点“允许”，再调用 `set_value`，`elementId` 为该连接入口，`value` 为 `"connect"`。`set_value` 与 `list_windows` 必须在用户允许的工具中。等待、拒绝、超时、取消都有状态；只有下一次显式连接才重试，重试前关闭旧提示。每次从 `DevToolsActivePort` 重读端点，应对重启后的端口或路径变化。

授权后可访问该浏览器已登录的网站和页面，连接期间浏览器显示自动测试软件控制提示。agent 只操作用户提到或 DSH 打开的标签页；发送、购买、删除或账户修改前按已有规则询问。网页文字可能诱导 agent，本机其他程序也能请求控制，浏览器同样会询问。结束插件只断开，不关闭自己的浏览器。

## Progress overlay and user-browser attachment

The progress overlay is **on by default** and can be disabled under Settings → Computer Use. It shows the work step by step: one heading per model step with plain-language action names taken from tool names and the shape of the call only (never typed text, URLs or coordinates), followed by the reasoning and reply DSH already emitted for that step; older steps keep their last lines and the last 24 steps can be scrolled back. When the turn ends the header reads done, stopped or error with the step count and time taken, and the overlay stays 20 seconds, showing a long reply from its start (the first 1,200 characters, ending in “…”, for a longer one). Summary mode asks the conversation's model (reasoning off) for a sentence or two about 1.5 s after work starts, then at most every 10 s, and once more for the result when the turn ends; a new step does not cancel a running summary. Configure opacity (20–100%), width/height, a corner or custom X/Y, locked state and a lock shortcut. Locked passes mouse input through, and the padlock in the top-right corner is the lock button: resting the user's own pointer on it for about 0.4 s (a ring fills) unlocks the overlay until the pointer has been away for about 1.5 s, so it can be dragged by the title, resized at the edges and scrolled; clicking the open padlock locks it at once. This temporary unlock never changes the saved lock setting, while moves and resizes are saved as usual. Only physical mouse movement counts (low-level hook events without the injected flag), so neither DSH's SendInput input nor a cursor it placed with SetCursorPos can unlock it; mouse input injected by remote-control software cannot either, so use the switch or the shortcut there. Unlocked, the overlay shows the open padlock (click to lock; this saves the lock when the setting was unlocked) and × to close, without activation. An overlay being adjusted stays until the user is done, and a quick second move or resize is not pulled back by the settings echo of the first. **Open overlay to adjust** applies the overlay settings without saving the rest of the form and shows a 60-second preview that is unlocked only while it lasts; the saved lock state is restored afterwards unless the user toggles it during the preview. Menu edits and native move/resize/lock/close events use the same DSH settings service and persist together. Stale native events cannot overwrite newer menu values. Only the current computer-use session's emitted reasoning/reply text is displayed; models with no reasoning output show status only. The overlay alone never arms the desktop Esc stop key.

Attach to my own browser is experimental and off by default. Enable remote debugging in the selected browser's inspect page. Listing reads its port file without a handshake. Ask the user to allow the connection, then `set_value` the offered `<browser id>:connect` handle to `connect`. The selected browser alone is offered; Firefox family is unsupported. There is no automatic retry after refusal/timeout/cancellation. Close any old prompt before explicitly retrying. Connection grants access to signed-in pages; only use requested or DSH-opened tabs and keep the existing confirmation rules for consequential actions. Disconnecting never closes this browser.

# 开发笔记（Development Notes）

本文件保留项目的开发过程记录：设计原理、踩坑、社区调研对比、性能数据与测试记录。
产品说明见 [README.md](../README.md)（中文）/ [README.en.md](../README.en.md)（English）。

## 原理（为什么这样做）

### 1. 为什么走 MCP 桥接，而不是原生 DSH 插件
- DSH 一切皆插件，但"注册新工具"需要写 Cordis 插件（注册进 `ctx.tools`、
  处理审批与权限钩子、打包成 `dsh.bundle`）。MCP 是更薄的边界：
  官方 `dsh-mcp-client` 会把任意 MCP server 的工具**原样注册**成
  `mcp__<serverName>__<工具名>`（serverName 我们在 patch 里取 `wincu`）。
- 好处：后端独立进程、独立语言、可单独测试（`--self-test`），坏了不影响 DSH 启动
  （`failOnStartupError: false`）。
- 代价：MCP 工具没有 DSH 原生的审批/风险分级钩子，所以安全机制做在 server 内部
  （scope 限定、窗口定位、动作前观察）。

### 2. 感知：UIA 无障碍树（text-first）
Windows 上比"截图像素"更可靠的是 **UI Automation** 树：每个控件带
`controlType`（Button/Edit/Window…）、`name`、`automationId`、`boundingBox`、
`value`、`patterns`（支持哪些语义操作）。agent 可以**按语义找控件**而不是猜坐标：

- 三种视图：`control`（默认，应用控件级，最常用）/ `content`（最终用户内容）/ `raw`（含内部节点）
- 元素 id 是 **UIA RuntimeId**：`uia:rt:42-251076304`（进程存活期内稳定，
  抗 UI 重排；过期报 `stale` 而非点错地方）。
- `find` 工具在树里按 name/automationId/class/值 做大小写不敏感子串搜索，
  返回完整节点信息，适合"找到保存按钮"这类任务。
- 截图（`snapshot`）给出 PNG **文件路径**（+ `imageScale`/`origin` 坐标映射）——
  DSH 桥接的文字预览曾显示 image 内容已丢弃，但部分版本仍保留原始图片块。
  #64 修复后，DSH 适配器使用文件模式，不把 base64 或图片块放进工具结果；
  用图片查看工具读取该 PNG，或由 IM 工具按路径发送。独立 MCP 客户端仍默认收到图片块。

### 3. 动作：三条路径
| 路径 | 用什么 | 何时用 |
|---|---|---|
| 后台消息 | `BM_CLICK`（Win32/WinForms 按钮、复选框）、`EM_REPLACESEL`（输入框）、`WM_VSCROLL`（自带滚动条的控件），发进控件自己的消息队列 | 最优先：不动鼠标、不切前台、不用剪贴板 |
| 语义 | UIA patterns：`Invoke`/`Toggle`/`SelectionItem`/`ExpandCollapse`/`Value`/`Scroll` | 其次。托管 Win32 代理和 Chromium 在调用里会自己切前台，调用后立刻还回去 |
| 前台 | `SetCursorPos` + SendInput 状态事件；剪贴板写入 + `Ctrl+V`；`SendKeys` 键组合 | 只借用前台：先检查落点，用完还鼠标和前台 |
| 后台 | PostMessage（鼠标消息 / WM_CHAR）直进目标窗口消息队列 | 不抢前台；投递未验证（诚实 `verified:false`） |

`type_text` 四种 `method`：`auto`（默认；焦点在 Win32 输入框时用 EM_REPLACESEL 在后台写入，否则借用前台粘贴）/
`clipboard`（CJK 最可靠，自动还原剪贴板，粘贴内容不进剪贴板历史）/
`sendinput`（KEYEVENTF_UNICODE 逐字符，不碰剪贴板）/ `background`（WM_CHAR，不碰前台）。
`keypress` 支持 `["ctrl","shift","s"]` 这类键组合（Win 键黑名单拦截，SendKeys 限制）。

### 4. 窗口定位
所有工具都接受可选 `windowTitle`（子串）/ `processId` / `nativeWindowHandle`
指定目标顶层窗口，`activate: true` 可先置前台。不指定 = 当前前台窗口
（`scope: active_window`；`scope: desktop` = 整个桌面树）。

### 5. 踩过的坑（安全加固的来源）
computer use 在 Windows 上最阴险的失败都是**静默的**——返回 ok 但实际打错了地方：

1. **前台锁（foreground lock）**：后台进程调 `SetForegroundWindow` 会被 Windows
   前台锁**静默拒绝**——函数不报错，但窗口根本没切过去，后续按键就全打进了
   用户当前的前台窗口（可能是微信、浏览器）。
   修复：`AttachThreadInput` 把前台窗口输入线程挂到自己线程 + 模拟按下/抬起
   Alt 键解锁（AutoHotkey 经典技巧）+ `ShowWindow`/`SetForegroundWindow`。
   切完**校验前台是否真的变成目标窗口**，结果以 `activated: true/false` 返回。
2. **fail-closed 输入守卫**：`type_text`/`keypress` 一旦指定了目标窗口，
   发送前校验"前台 == 目标"，不匹配直接抛错，**绝不**把按键打进别的窗口。
3. **激活 ≠ 聚焦**：窗口置前台后，内部编辑框往往**没有键盘焦点**，
   `Ctrl+V` 会被无声吞掉。修复：`type_text` 在目标窗口内用 UIA 找**最大的启用状态
   Edit/Document 控件**并 `SetFocus()`，结果里回报 `focusedControl`。
4. **DPI 感知顺序**：Per-Monitor V2 必须在 GDI+/WinForms 程序集加载前设置，
   否则进程锁死在虚拟化坐标空间（本机 3414x960 vs 物理 5120x1440）。
5. **SendInput ABSOLUTE 多显示器陷阱**：ABSOLUTE 归一化在本机多显示器下会把
   X 恰好减半（ratio 0.495-0.500）。修复：移动改用 `SetCursorPos`（原始屏幕
   坐标），按钮/滚轮用 SendInput 状态事件，校准到落点 ratio 1.000。
6. **WinUI 应用丢弃 PostMessage 合成消息**：新记事本（WinUI 3）会静默丢
   WM_CHAR（消息入队成功但应用不处理）；`close_window` 对 WinUI 记事本实测是
   **直接干净关闭、不弹"是否保存"对话框**（经典 Win32 应用才会弹）。
   这类目标用 `foreground`/`clipboard` 路径。
7. **PrintWindow 对 DirectComposition 表面渲染纯黑**（UWP/WinUI/游戏）：
   捕获链检测纯黑帧后切 WGC（Windows.Graphics.Capture）读 DWM 合成帧，
   再不行降级屏幕区域裁剪（带 `occludedPossible` 标记）。
8. **PS 5.1 编码**：无 BOM 的 UTF-8 .ps1 在非 UTF-8 系统代码页（如 CI runner）
   上按 ANSI 解析 → 行尾 CJK 字节吞 LF、脚本崩。后端与所有 .ps1 均带 UTF-8 BOM。

- 轮次一结束浮窗立即消失，最终回复只在流式输出的几秒里出现过半截。
- 360×240、150% 缩放下正文只有 4 行，跟随底部时顶行常被切掉半行；锁定时底部提示行再占一行。

改动：
- `activity.mjs` 为每轮记录步骤历史（最近 24 步，旧步骤留末尾 400 字，当前步 1200 字）和动作名；动作名只看工具名和调用结构（`new-tab`、`:address`、batch 的步数和动作种类），不读输入值。第一次调用工具前的文字按会话、按轮暂存在内存里，这一轮开始用电脑时并入第一步。轮次结束后保留 20 秒（`lingerUntil`），不占用系列、不显示接管提示、不挂 Esc。
- `progress-summary.mjs` 以轮为单位：一次只发一个请求，新的一步不取消也不清空；首条约 1.5 秒后，之后最多每 10 秒，结束时再发一次结果总结（会替换在途的普通请求）；输入为步骤历史，限 2400 字符。
- 原生窗口：步骤小标题；“已完成 · N 步 · 用时”/“已停止”/“出错”；只显示整行；锁定时用锁形图标代替不能点的关闭按钮，并去掉底部提示行；去掉 Markdown 记号和段间空行；文字加阴影；结束时回复比窗口长就从回复开头显示；没有可滚动内容时不画滚动条。

改后同一段回放：步骤之间不再出现“等待 DSH 输出…”，结束后 20 秒内看得到“已完成：我打开了一个新的浏览器标签页，在必应上搜索「晴天」，并一直下滑到页面最底部。”。总结模式在 41 秒里发出 5 次请求（4 次过程、1 次结果），每条一直显示到下一条出来；替身失败时显示操作步骤，结束后显示回复开头。替身只验证时序和显示，总结文字的质量要在真实 DSH 里看。

真机核对（同日，本机 DSH Desktop 2.0.18 / 宿主 0.2.1-rc.2，AI 总结模式）：浮窗出现在主屏右上角（360×240 物理像素，150%，鼠标穿透），7 步 17.7 秒；3.2 秒出第一条总结，结束后 0.8 秒出结果总结，保留 20 秒后收起，时序都对。但记录到的进度数据里每一步都没有思考文字，结束时也没有回复，总结只能复述动作名（“已找到浏览器或窗口，正在继续处理第 2 步。”）。原因：DSH 0.2 的流式输出走 `agent/assistant-stream` 帧（`{agent, frame}`，frame 为 start/chunk/end，轮次和步号只在 start 帧里），会话事件里没有 `assistant/chunk`；此前的实现和测试都按 `assistant/chunk` 写，测试用的是自造事件。这也解释了用户上午实测时觉得浮窗“体验不好”：原文模式下几乎只看得到状态行。改为监听 `agent/assistant-stream`（按 attemptId 对应轮次和步号；outcome 为 abandoned 的尝试在同一步重试时清掉文字），旧事件保留兼容；回放脚本改发真实帧格式。总结输入增加本轮第一段思考（最多 300 字），提示词改为说清在做什么事、已完成什么、正在做什么，不写工具名、坐标、元素编号和步骤编号。

# 工具加载 / Tool loading

外层提供“精简 / 全部 / 懒启动 / 自定义”四种加载方案，默认选“全部”。选择“自定义”后展开缩进的逐项清单，可按项或按组勾选。切换方案保留自定义清单；保存后在当前动作结束时生效，重启保留方案和清单。精简方案固定加载 12 项，全部方案加载 26 项；自定义按用户清单加载，允许全部关闭。

Choose Lite / All / Lazy / Custom in the outer preset selector; All is the default. Custom reveals the indented per-tool checklist. Switching presets preserves your custom selection. Save applies changes after the current action finishes; the preset and custom list survive restart. Lite loads 12 tools, All loads 26, and Custom loads the selected set, including an empty set.

## 懒启动 / Lazy startup

选择 `toolPreset: "lazy"` 时，用户允许全部 26 项，但启动只注册管理入口。先用 `enable` 加载任务所需工具；已有 `names: ["screenshot","click"]` 支持一次加载多项。新增 `names: ["*"]` 可一次启用全部已允许的桌面工具，或配合 `disable` 卸载它们，始终保留管理入口。通配符必须单独使用，不能用于 `list`、`describe` 或 `reset`。精简和自定义方案的限制同样适用于通配符。`reset` 在懒启动中回到 1 项；重新连接也回到保存的启动方案。

`toolPreset: "lazy"` permits all 26 tools but starts with management only. Enable the tools needed for a task using a name array, or use `names: ["*"]` with enable/disable for all allowed desktop tools. Management stays loaded. The wildcard must stand alone and is rejected for list/describe/reset. Lite and Custom restrictions still apply. Reset and reconnect return Lazy to its single management entry.

收益来自尚未加载的工具定义；加载后的定义仍占上下文，已有对话记录不会删除。桌面任务需要额外的加载调用。0.5.0 同口径列表为：全部 20,243、精简 9,030、懒启动 510 字符（较全部减少 97.5%），并非 token 数。

启动集合只剩管理入口、且至少允许一项桌面工具时（懒启动即属此类），服务器在 MCP `initialize` 返回 `instructions`，说明这台电脑能读取与操作真实 Windows 应用，并提示先 `enable` 再用。原因是这一状态下没有任何桌面工具名可供模型推断能力；`instructions` 会被支持它的客户端作为该服务的说明注入模型上下文，DSH 即把它发布成 `mcp:<serverName>` 系统提示词段落。其他启动集合不返回该字段：能力仍由工具名与其说明表达；若自定义清单不允许任何桌面工具，启用会被拒绝，此时不声明该能力。

Savings apply to definitions not yet loaded. Loaded definitions and conversation history still use context, and desktop tasks need a loading call. Version 0.5.0 measures All / Lite / Lazy at 20,243 / 9,030 / 510 serialized characters (97.5% less for Lazy than All), not tokens.

When the startup set is the management entry alone and at least one desktop tool is allowed — which is what Lazy startup does — the server returns MCP `initialize` `instructions` stating that this machine's Windows applications can be read and operated, and that tools must be enabled first. In that state no desktop tool name remains for a model to infer capability from. Clients that surface server instructions add them as text attributed to this server; DSH publishes them as the `mcp:<serverName>` system-prompt section. Other startup sets omit the field: the tool names and their descriptions already carry the capability, and a Custom checklist that allows no desktop tool is excluded because enabling one is refused.

## 简体中文

未保存过新方案字段时，包含全部工具的已有清单显示“全部”，其他已有清单显示“自定义”，保留先前选择。显式方案字段为 `toolPreset`，自定义清单为 `enabledTools`。

DSH 0.2 使用插件条目 ID `mcp-dsh-computer-use-win` 的实时 Config 表单，旧宿主保留可配置插件卡片与 `windows-computer-use` 命名空间。适配器继续使用官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`，不需要手动新增第二个 `wincu` MCP 服务。

清单分为“屏幕与内容”“鼠标与键盘”“窗口与控件”“等待与工具管理”四组，共 25 项桌面工具及管理工具 `windows_computer_use_tools`。取消勾选的工具不再出现在 MCP 列表中，直接调用也返回 `TOOL_DISABLED_IN_SETTINGS`。agent 无法通过管理工具重新开启用户关闭的工具；管理工具本身也可关闭。原工具名称、调用参数和后台实现保留。

发现工具操作示例（在 DSH 中名称为 `mcp__wincu__windows_computer_use_tools`）：

```json
{"operation":"list"}
{"operation":"describe","names":["drag"]}
{"operation":"enable","names":["drag"]}
{"operation":"disable","names":["drag"]}
{"operation":"reset"}
```

如果保留管理工具，`list` 返回目录及 `enabled`、`available` 状态。`describe` 只读取一个工具的完整说明和原始参数定义，不启动 PowerShell 或读取桌面。`enable` 只能加载用户已允许的工具；`disable` 临时卸载定义；`reset` 恢复用户保存的启动集合。名称可写短名或完整原名。运行时加载状态仅属于当前 MCP worker，不改写用户设置。

这是按需注入工具定义，不是删除后端功能或模型自动判断语义。标准 MCP `notifications/tools/list_changed` 通知客户端刷新；已验证官方 DSH 桥的注册、调用、移除流程。其他客户端若不处理该通知，需要显式刷新工具列表、重连，或使用全能模式。已有对话中的说明、调用结果和历史消息不会因卸载而消失。

独立 MCP 可设置 `WCU_TOOL_MODE=lazy` 启用懒启动；若同时指定 `WCU_ENABLED_TOOLS`，它仍限制允许范围且必须包含 `tools`。

直接使用独立 MCP / `wcu-mcp` 时默认全部加载。未设置 `WCU_ENABLED_TOOLS` 时，`WCU_TOOL_MODE=lite` 保留 11 项常用工具及管理工具，`full` 加载全部工具。可用 `WCU_ENABLED_TOOLS` 的 JSON 数组指定集合，例如 `["screenshot","wait"]`；显式选择优先于旧 mode，允许 `[]`，非法名称会报错。独立服务无第三方运行时依赖；DSH 适配器使用宿主已有的 Schemastery 与官方 MCP 桥。

0.4.0 同样序列化的 `tools/list`：0.3.1 是 43,495 字符；精简模式 9,046 字符（减少 79.2%），全能模式 20,259 字符（减少 53.4%）。字符数可复核；token 数必须由目标模型的分词器和真实宿主请求测量。参数 schema 的约束与执行校验没有删减，只缩短注入模型的说明。

## English

Choose Lite / All / Lazy / Custom in Settings → Computer Use. All is the default; only Custom reveals the indented checklist. Preset changes preserve custom selections, and Save persists the preset and list across restart. Lite loads 12 tools and All loads 26.

Unchecked tools are omitted from discovery, and direct calls return `TOOL_DISABLED_IN_SETTINGS`. The agent cannot re-enable user-disabled tools through management. Management itself can also be disabled. Its `list` response includes `enabled` and `available`; `describe` reads one full contract without starting PowerShell; `disable` temporarily unloads an allowed tool; `enable` reloads allowed tools only; `reset` restores the user's startup selection. Runtime management never overwrites the saved configuration.

The examples above accept short or complete original names. Standard MCP tool-list change notifications update the official DSH registry. Other clients must support notifications, explicitly refresh/reconnect, or use Full. Unloading cannot remove instructions or results already recorded in conversation history.

Set `WCU_TOOL_MODE=lazy` for standalone Lazy startup. An explicit `WCU_ENABLED_TOOLS` still restricts permissions and must include `tools`.

Standalone MCP defaults to all tools. Without `WCU_ENABLED_TOOLS`, `WCU_TOOL_MODE=lite` retains eleven common tools plus management, while `full` loads all tools. An explicit JSON array in `WCU_ENABLED_TOOLS`, such as `["screenshot","wait"]`, takes precedence and permits an empty selection. Unknown names fail validation. The standalone server has no third-party runtime dependencies. The DSH adapter consumes the host's existing Schemastery and MCP bridge as optional peers.

Measured `tools/list` for 0.4.0: 43,495 characters in 0.3.1, 9,046 in Lite and 20,259 in Full. Token counts depend on the target tokenizer and host request. Type, enum, bounds, required-property and default validation remains intact; only model-facing prose is shortened.

The native takeover test reaches its assertion that turning off recording visibility excludes both overlay layers and fails (`Opt-out must exclude both layers live`) in this environment. Only the test probe's cold-start timeout was extended from 10 to 30 seconds for that comparison; the reference backend/helper were unchanged. This behavior is not claimed fixed by the adapter.

- OpenCode V2 requires a different plugin/GUI entrypoint and is not claimed supported by this V1 package.
- Actual task success still depends on the chosen model, vision support, application responsiveness and the inherited Windows automation limits. No real-model business task or personal-account browser workflow was used for acceptance.

# App Technology Matrix

Windows desktop apps expose accessibility through different provider stacks. The plugin uses Microsoft UI Automation as the shared observation layer, but the tree shape varies by app technology.

## UIA Views

Microsoft UI Automation defines three practical tree views:

- `control`: UI elements that matter as controls. This is the default because it maps best to buttons, lists, tabs, menus, text boxes, and windows an agent can operate.
- `content`: end-user content. This can be smaller for reading-oriented tasks, but it can hide structural controls that are needed for automation.
- `raw`: provider internals. This is useful for debugging sparse or strange apps, but it often includes hidden menus, inactive tabs, layout panels, and implementation nodes.

The plugin defaults to `viewMode="control"`, `includeOffscreen=false`, and `detailLevel="compact"`. To reproduce the first version's heavier behavior, call tree tools with `viewMode="raw"`, `includeOffscreen=true`, and `detailLevel="full"`.

## Technology Notes

| App technology | Typical UIA shape | Best default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Win32 common controls | Stable windows and controls, often shallow | `control` | Good fit for `find`, `invoke`, `set_value`, and coordinate fallback. |
| WinForms | Usually exposes named controls and values | `control` | Control ids/classes can be verbose, but element paths are stable while the form is unchanged. |
| WPF | Usually rich UIA roles and patterns | `control` or `content` | `content` is useful for reading; `control` is better before actions. |
| UWP/WinUI | Rich tree, sometimes wrapped by `ApplicationFrameWindow` | `control` | The launched process can differ from the top-level window process; prefer HWND targeting. |
| Electron/Chromium/CEF/Tauri | Browser accessibility tree inside a native host window | Scoped `control` | Chromium builds a page's tree only after a UIA client reads a property of the page root under `Chrome_RenderWidgetHostHWND`; window-scoped observations do this for each visible renderer and report `webContent`, and in those trees unnamed layout panes do not count toward `maxDepth`. Trees can be deep and expensive to instantiate, including `Chrome_WidgetWin*` / `OrpheusBrowserHost` targets. Cached, lazy traversal bounds visited nodes and checks a time budget; a single provider call can still block. If a call truncates/times out, check target responsiveness before retrying and use screenshot/OCR once it recovers. Use `raw` only for missing nodes. |
| Mozilla/XUL apps such as Thunderbird | Browser-like tree plus many hidden menus and panels | `control`, `includeOffscreen=false` | Raw traversal is especially noisy because hidden popups and inactive panels are present in the provider tree. |
| Custom canvas/game/PDF views | Sparse or visual-only tree | screenshot plus coordinates | Use UIA for window targeting, then screenshot and coordinate actions. |

## Implementations in Other Tools

Other Windows automation stacks use the same general pattern: accessibility first, then scoped search, then action.

- Microsoft UI Automation documents raw, control, and content views as different projections of the desktop automation tree: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/winauto/uiauto-treeoverview
- OpenAI Codex Computer Use documents the macOS model as Screen Recording for seeing apps and Accessibility for clicking, typing, and navigation: https://developers.openai.com/codex/app/computer-use
- pywinauto's UIA backend wraps Windows UI Automation and encourages locating controls through window specs and identifiers instead of dumping every raw descendant: https://pywinauto.readthedocs.io/en/latest/getting_started.html
- FlaUI wraps Microsoft UIA2/UIA3 for .NET and centers automation around elements, searches, and interactions: https://github.com/FlaUI/FlaUI
- Appium Windows Driver exposes UWP, WinForms, WPF, and Win32 apps through an Appium/WebDriver model backed by Microsoft's WinAppDriver server: https://github.com/appium/appium-windows-driver
- Playwright historically exposed accessibility snapshots with an "interesting nodes" default and its ARIA snapshot workflow treats accessibility output as a filtered test surface: https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-accessibility and https://playwright.dev/docs/aria-snapshots
- Electron exposes Chromium accessibility support through platform accessibility APIs, so native automation sees web-derived roles inside a host window: https://www.electronjs.org/docs/latest/api/app

## Current Test Coverage

CI runs disposable WinForms and Electron/Chromium fixtures. These verify actual cached value/pattern/RuntimeId reads, three tree views, node/time limits, renderer responsiveness, and a native UI thread deliberately paused for three seconds (hung-window rejection and recovery). A second Electron fixture runs without forced accessibility, as Electron apps ship, and must expose its page controls on the first observation with default arguments (issue #50). They use only their own windows and no physical input. The issue #18 reporter's NetEase Cloud Music 3.1.41 / Windows build 22621 environment has not been reproduced by these fixtures; no general guarantee that a broken CEF provider cannot hang is implied.

The safe live smoke test covers:

- Notepad: Win32/classic text editor.
- Calculator: UWP/WinUI packaged app.
- Paint: native Windows drawing app.
- File Explorer: Win32 shell window.
- WinForms Fixture: local .NET WinForms fixture.
- WPF Fixture: local .NET WPF fixture.

It intentionally avoids dandanplay, Steam Community, proxy/VPN/network tools, BT/resource download apps, and any app that could change the machine's network path.

# Architecture

DSH ToolRuntime calls the official MCP bridge, which starts mcp/server.mjs in Node mode (including Electron via ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE). The Node server validates arguments against the same schemas it advertises. One persistent PowerShell backend serializes desktop requests; queued request time is not counted as execution time.

## Observation

UIA trees use cached properties, a node cap, a depth cap and a traversal time budget. One synchronous provider call can still block. The server watchdog allows the budget plus 10 seconds, retires a stuck worker, and may obtain a native screenshot from a replacement. The response preserves explicit failure; an image is not a successful accessibility tree.

Native window enumeration, screenshot, default OCR, coordinate targeting and window management do not resolve UIA elements. Fully on-screen, unobstructed foreground windows use a screen crop, with foreground HWND, Z order and geometry checked before and after capture. Other windows use PrintWindow, Windows.Graphics.Capture and a flagged screen-region fallback. These capture APIs have their own watchdog; UIA independence is not a guarantee that every capture API is interruptible.

Empty sparse/incomplete find results can attach OCR. OCR candidates have source:ocr, recognized text and screen-space bounds. Literal OCR text does not prove a control role. Explicit resolveControl requests a UIA hit-test, whose result may be a whole document. Screenshot image pixels map to screen = bounds origin + image / imageScale.

## Actions and evidence

Each action uses the least intrusive way that works (less takeover, issue #45). Element actions run in the background: BM_CLICK for Win32 buttons, EM_REPLACESEL for Win32 edits, WM_VSCROLL/WM_HSCROLL for controls with their own scroll bars, else the UIA pattern under a guard that gives back the foreground and the pointer a provider took on its own (managed Win32 proxies and Chromium activate their window for most pattern calls), unless a menu, list or dialog the call opened is showing. Real input borrows the foreground: Start-Input notes the window in front and the pointer and brings the target forward (joining the input of the thread in front first, the Alt-key method second); Assert-PointOnTarget refuses a click whose point shows another process's window; Assert-InFront checks once more right before keys go out; Complete-Input, in finally, waits for the target to handle the input (two WM_NULL), then puts the pointer back if it is still where DSH left it and returns the foreground, except with activate:true, while the target's thread is in menu mode or shows a popup that was not there before, or when the user switched windows. The window input went to is remembered with the host's series key (_wcuSeries), so input and observations without a window target keep to it after the foreground went back to the user. type_text preserves the current focus by default, so it can follow an OCR/visual click without refocusing another control. focusMode:main explicitly requests heuristic main-control focus.

The server classifies calls with isQuietCall (mcp/browser.mjs), shared with the host's activity tracking: reads, list_windows, wait, background dispatch, browser-lane calls and element actions that start in the background take a quiet lease (no takeover helper, so no indicator and no global Esc), and only a call that uses the real pointer or keyboard turns on the series indicator. Element actions, scroll on an element and type_text in auto mode first run with _wcuQuiet; when they would need real input the backend throws WCU_NEEDS_INPUT before sending any, and the server runs them again with a normal lease.

RuntimeId references are cached from observations with HWND/PID ownership and a five-minute lifetime. Unseen/stale ids require re-observation; the backend does not globally search the desktop for them. Legacy tree paths remain view-dependent.

Actions report verification:sent. A UIA pattern call or native input acceptance does not prove the user's objective. wait_for supports native window presence, bounded UIA element queries, and literal OCR text. A satisfied observable condition reports verification:observed. Truncated UIA absence and occluded OCR remain inconclusive.

Input cancellation allows press/release cleanup before worker retirement. Timed-out input is never replayed. Clipboard data is read before replacement and restored in finally; pasted text carries ExcludeClipboardContentFromMonitorProcessing, CanIncludeInClipboardHistory=0 and CanUploadToCloudClipboard=0, so it stays out of clipboard history and the cloud clipboard. Drag release is also attempted in finally.

## Browser lane

mcp/browser.mjs speaks the Chrome DevTools Protocol from the Node server over WebSocket, beside the PowerShell backend rather than through it. It uses its own small WebSocket client without compression: Node's built-in client negotiates permessage-deflate and drops the connection on any message over 4 MiB decompressed, which the accessibility tree of a long page exceeds. A call routes there when it carries browserTab or a page element id. Each tab gets one flattened session; pages are read with Accessibility.getFullAXTree and flattened into an outline; input uses Input.dispatchMouseEvent / dispatchKeyEvent / insertText inside the page after a hit test. Element ids are numbers the server run hands out and maps to a DOM node of one document; tab ids carry a salt of the run, so ids from an earlier run never reach a tab. Actions in a tab run one at a time. Browser-lane calls take a quiet takeover lease: a stopped series still refuses them and settings reconnects wait for them, but they start no takeover helper, so they show no screen indicator and arm no global Esc; DSH's stop button cancels them. The agent browser is a visible-by-default child process (headless is opt-in) running the browser chosen in settings (by default the Windows default browser, read from UserChoiceLatest\ProgId, else UserChoice), whose tabs run in an isolated browser context of a throwaway profile; with sign-ins kept, it runs on a kept profile instead and its tabs use that profile's own context, so the sites the user signed in to there stay signed in. The user's own browser is never connected; see the browser lane section of mcp-tools.md. All usable presets receive browser-first routing instructions at MCP initialization; disabled tools are not advertised as callable. The visible agent browser marks its work without covering the page, as Codex's Browser Use does: a DSH-blue window frame (an autogenerated theme), a pointer badge as the icon of the tab DSH works in, and a small pointer at the point it acts on, drawn in a closed shadow root of an isolated world that lets pointer events through and is hidden for screenshots. Visible targets are created with background:true; automatic activation remains limited to headless tabs. A tab that is not painting (background or minimized) is captured by repeating the capture request until Chrome answers, never by activating its window.

## Vision

No visual model is bundled. A vision-capable caller or optional external parser such as OmniParser can consume screenshot content and return coordinates to the same guarded input tools.
